CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];
    _filename text;
BEGIN
    -- Split on "/" to get path segments
    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
    -- Get the last path segment (the actual filename)
    SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename;
    -- Extract extension: reverse, split on '.', then reverse again
    RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1));
END
$function$

 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];

END
$function$

functions.name: foldername
functions.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];
BEGIN
    -- Split on "/" to get path segments
    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
    -- Return everything except the last segment
    RETURN _parts[1 : array_length(_parts,1) - 1];
END
$function$

functions.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tenant_smtp_executor.tenant_smtp_dispatch_ready(p_org uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.tenant_smtp_dispatch_gate WHERE id AND approved)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.tenant_smtp_f4_gate WHERE id AND approved)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.tenant_smtp_test_gate WHERE id AND approved)
 AND platform_private.tenant_smtp_f4_verified(p_org)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.tenant_smtp_activation a JOIN public.communication_tenant_email_settings s ON s.organization_id=a.organization_id
  JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=a.organization_id
  WHERE a.organization_id=p_org AND a.active AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND a.version=s.version AND a.from_email=lower(s.config->>'from_email')
  AND s.credential_configured AND s.config->>'port'='465' AND s.config->>'tls_mode'='implicit_tls')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_fail_org_admin_provisioning(p_job_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_error_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_role := coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role',true),''),
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')::jsonb->>'role','');
  IF v_role<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.platform_org_admin_invites SET status='falhou',lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,
    last_error_code=left(coalesce(p_error_code,'unknown'),40),updated_at=now()
  WHERE id=p_job_id AND status='processando' AND lease_token=p_lease_token;
  RETURN FOUND;
END
$function$
